answer: Cheap aliases stall at a canyon toll that cannot run in parallel. A key sinks 1.44 POA and keeps a 19-hour watch on a public reef bench. It files five inked quill notes, each a 22-byte digest bound to the sink receipt and spaced at least 205 minutes apart. Four auditors on distinct /18 prefixes replay the notes from the live tip and reject any reused 8-byte collar. If two watches share a four-note spine, or eleven sinks leave one wallet in 48 minutes, every colliding watch is torn down and the burn stays sunk. A skipped note never finishes the toll; the bench cannot be transferred.
